title: Multi-column drop with a properly keyed copy
expected_feedback: Standard, not critical: the copy carries both columns being dropped plus `id`, which survives the statement and can key a MERGE back. That is the targeted snapshot pattern applied correctly to a multi-column drop. Still to confirm, because the script cannot show it: that `id` is genuinely unique, and that the CTAS completed before the ALTER ran. The drop itself remains irreversible and auto-commits, so the phase is restore/PITR — and someone should own dropping mig_bak_orders once the migration is signed off.
violated_rule: Irreversible statements need a pre-DDL artefact
